name: TalentOS Hiring Copilot
description: Memory-native hiring copilot for OpenClaw with auto-recall, auto-capture, and structured hiring workflows powered by Mem0.

baseUrl.description: Optional: view server URL (for future use). Hiring uses Mem0 only.

apiKey.description: Optional: view server API key if used.

mem0ApiKey.description: Mem0 API key for auto-recall and auto-capture hooks.

userId.description: Mem0 user ID for memory scoping.

autoRecall.description: Inject relevant hiring memories before every agent turn.

autoCapture.description: Extract and store hiring facts after every agent turn.

minPromptLength.description: Skip auto-recall for prompts shorter than this.
